result.reviewDetail: 2 code files with no importer (apps/web/components/next-step-card.tsx, apps/web/components/ux/page-header.tsx, the same two the Conductor found), and 7 CSS files with class selectors named in no tracked source file (globals.css 39, move-view.css 4, work-list.css 3 plus 1 named only by tests, operator-overview.css 1, owner-page.css 2, source-ledger.css 2, ux-kit.css 1). No unreferenced image, font or other asset, and no unreferenced test helper, was found.
result.keepDetail: 15 documented operator scripts named by path in documents, 4 standard package entry points (check, dev, format, start).

preserved: Nothing is deleted. The never-touched trees (docs/source, docs/v3/history, ADRs, docs/qa, frozen evidence, migrations and installers, the contract, requirement identities) are excluded from the scan and a test keeps them out of the report.
Routes are not judged here; route coverage stays with scripts/revamp-manifest.mjs (127 routes, 0 unmapped).
Documentation mentions are recorded but never keep a file alive and never remove one.
limits: Names built from strings other than template-string prefixes cannot be seen by a static scan. The report lists the 42 prefixes it honoured; a class kept only by one is listed as kept by prefix, not as a candidate.
A CSS selector named only in documents or fixtures that are not tracked source would show as unreferenced; K-02 decides each one.
nextAction: K-02 (Conductor): mark each REVIEW entry KEEP, CONSOLIDATE or DELETE-AFTER-PROOF in docs/revamp/CLEANUP-MANIFEST.json. K-03 (S4) deletes only approved DELETE entries, after an independent adversarial review.
